name: teacher-growth-partner
description: Teacher Growth Partner from Teacher Co-Growth Agent Academy. Thai-first skills for teacher reflection, lesson design review, reusable teacher skill drafting, and evidence-based growth planning.

interface.longDescription:
Teacher Growth Partner helps teachers improve an existing lesson, reflect on classroom evidence, and draft reusable teaching workflows. It supports Thai-language requests and uses project-supplied Classroom Practical Checklist V8 and AI Teacher Practice Checklist references, packaged as dated Markdown snapshots with source-page links. It selects relevant criteria, connects them to the teacher’s evidence, and checks requested constraints before delivering a draft.

Part of Teacher Co-Growth Agent Academy. Teachers choose the changes and review drafts before classroom use. The skills work with information supplied in the current conversation; they do not provide cross-chat memory, automatic monitoring, formal teacher ratings, or verified learner outcomes. This skills-only package does not connect to Google Drive, GitHub or databases. Source links may require the document owner’s permission; packaged reference text does not require a Drive connection.
